cohort: The participants were pregnant women admitted to the labour room at a government medical college and hospital.
finding: The implementation of an adapted birth companion policy during the COVID-19 pandemic led to an increase in birth companion support use from 20% to 82% and a decrease in caesarean section and operative vaginal delivery rates.
mod_finding: The study found that the caesarean section rate decreased from 29.16% to 26.09%, and the need for operative vaginal deliveries decreased from 2.24% to 1.8% over the study period.
